venues.name: & Change
venues.notes: Open only to poets who identify as gay men. Simultaneous submissions welcome but poet must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not accepted. Poems published in pairs with max 44 characters per line and ~65 lines total across both poems. Response: around April, August, and December

venues.name: 32 Poems
venues.notes: Send no more than five poems per submission and no more than one active submission at a time. Do not submit translations or previously published work (in print or online). Response: Usually within three weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Current subscribers. Free for current subscribers; subscription available via website

venues.name: A&U Magazine
venues.submitEmail: Noah Stetzer Poetry Editor (email address obfuscated as [email protected])
venues.pays: Yes—pay rates available on request
venues.notes: Poetry can be any length/style. Submit as Word or PDF attachment to Poetry Editor Noah Stetzer. Include in email body: name, mailing address, phone number, and short bio (four or fewer sentences). Previously unpublished work only. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Acentos Review
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions acceptable with immediate notification of publication. Previously published material not considered. First North American serial rights exclusive through last day of publication month. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Afternoon Visitor
venues.notes: Submit 3-8 poems in one PDF or Word document, maximum 10 pages. One submission at a time; wait for response before submitting again. No more than twice a year. Include third-person bio and cover letter. Simultaneous submissions allowed, but must withdraw promptly if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not accepted. Response: five months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Allium, A Journal of Poetry & Prose
venues.ai: AI-generated work will not be considered.
venues.notes: Maximum five poems (up to seven total pages) with no more than one poem per page. Do not submit more than once per genre per reading cycle. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work and AI-generated work not considered.

waiver.note: Columbia College Chicago students. Columbia College Chicago students only are encouraged to submit via email using their Columbia College email address, bypassing the Submittable fee

venues.name: Always Crashing
venues.notes: Currently closed for journal submissions; typical reading period is May 15 - Sept 15. Submissions must be sent through their submission manager, not via email or post. One submission per submission period before hearing back; simultaneous submissions encouraged with immediate notification if accepted elsewhere.

venues.name: American Poetry Review
venues.pays: $1 per line of poetry
venues.notes: Send no more than five poems per submission. Previously published material not accepted. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: within six months

venues.name: ANMLY
venues.ai: Do not accept AI-generated or AI-assisted writing or art.
venues.notes: Attach up to five poems in a single document with a short bio in the cover letter field. Previously unpublished work only, including work on personal blogs. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: about four months

waiver.note: Black and Indigenous writers, and writers of Palestinian descent. Fees waived to support those most targeted by state violence. Also available for those experiencing financial hardship.

venues.name: Annulet: A Journal of Poetics
venues.notes: Submit up to 7 poems per submission with no length requirement. Wait to hear back before submitting again; limit submissions to twice per year maximum from your first submission date. Indicate if work is simultaneously submitted in cover letter. Include name in document or filename. Response: three months (aspirational)

venues.name: Anti-Heroin Chic
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems per email to submissions address with $3 fee. Subject line format: first name_last name_genre. Include 75-word max bio. Simultaneous submissions allowed but disclose in cover letter. Do not send PDFs or to editor's personal email. Response: within a month

venues.name: Appalachia Journal
venues.pays: two contributor copies
venues.notes: Send 3-5 poems; shorter poems preferred. Simultaneous submissions accepted but contact editor if poem accepted elsewhere. Publishes 6-8 poems per issue.

venues.name: Apple Valley Review
venues.notes: Submit maximum 6 unpublished poems per submission. Preference given to short (under two pages), non-rhyming poetry. Include "poetry" in subject line and cover letter with name, mailing address, email, and short third-person biography in body of email message. Only one submission at a time. Response: approximately three weeks, up to two months

venues.name: Asymptote
venues.notes: Poetry submissions should be up to 10 pages of translated work; if originals are included, the entire document may reach 20 pages maximum. Simultaneous submissions permitted but the journal must be notified of acceptances elsewhere. All submissions must be unpublished translations (source text may have been previously published). Rolling deadline year-round. Response: One month guaranteed from March 1, 2021 onwards

waiver.note: Writers based in sub-Saharan Africa or translating work from this region. Submissions are kept free for those based in sub-Saharan Africa or translating work from this region. The journal may offer exemptions for other regions in future.

venues.name: AzonaL
venues.notes: Submit translated poetry (about 4 poems) with source language versions included in a single .doc/.docx file. Include cover letter and bios (translator, any co-translators, poet—each ~200 words). Provide assurance of translation rights. One submission per issue only; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere.

venues.name: Barzakh Magazine
venues.notes: Poets may submit up to 3 poems in a single text file. Non-tip Jar submissions are free; optional Tip Jar donations ($3.00) are available. The venue notes they have limited Non-tip Jar slots and when full, only Tip Jar submissions will remain open.

venues.name: Bear Review
venues.notes: Maximum five poems per submission in single .doc, .docx, or pdf document. Wait one full calendar year after publication before resubmitting. Only unpublished work accepted; simultaneous submissions welcome with notification if accepted elsewhere. Response: two to four months, sometimes up to six

waiver.note: poets currently or previously incarcerated; poets writing while working only or mostly to make ends meet. Email query to request free-submission link. Good-faith requests only; links limited per Submittable plan.

venues.name: beestung
venues.pays: $20 honorarium
venues.ai: Do not accept AI-generated or AI-assisted writing or art.
venues.notes: Submit poetry via email to beestung@sundresspublications.com with brief biographical note. Venue is for non-binary, genderqueer, and two-spirit writers. Previously-published work not accepted. Currently closed for general work until December 31st, 2026. Response: at least 3 months

venues.name: Berkeley Poetry Review
venues.notes: Maximum 3 poems per reading period; previously unpublished work only; submit in single document via the link provided (not email). Simultaneous submissions allowed but withdraw immediately if accepted elsewhere. Cap: 3 per reading period Response: 8 weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: bethh
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions welcome; notify if work is accepted elsewhere. Submit up to 3 pieces in a singular attachment via submission manager.

venues.name: Better Than Starbucks Poetry & Fiction Journal
venues.pays: Up to 12 featured contributors receive $20 honorarium via PayPal upon publication; others receive free PDF or eBook version of issue
venues.notes: Submit via email with subject line indicating category/genre. Up to 4 poems per submission (6 if short forms under 6 lines). Include short bio (ideally 30 words, max 40). Include full name and return address. Do not submit different categories in same email. One submission per category per issue; wait for next issue's call before resubmitting to same category. Response: up to 90 days

venues.name: Big Other
venues.notes: Fee required for most submissions; venue is not a paying market. Simultaneous submissions accepted but must notify immediately upon acceptance elsewhere. Response time within one year. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Birdcoat Quarterly
venues.pays: $20 per poem
venues.notes: Up to four poems or maximum ten pages per submission in single document. Previously unpublished work only; First North American Serial Rights requested.

venues.name: Birmingham Poetry Review
venues.pays: one copy of the Birmingham Poetry Review
venues.notes: Submit three to five poems without cover letters. Must include stamped, self-addressed envelope (SASE). Does not accept electronic submissions. If work accepted elsewhere, contact immediately. Response: one to three months

venues.name: Biscuit Hill
venues.notes: Submit 3-6 poems in one document (PDF or DOC), maximum 10 pages, using readable fonts. Include name and email in header of each page. Simultaneous submissions allowed but withdraw if accepted elsewhere. No previously published work including social media. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Black Sun Lit — digital vestiges
venues.ai: We do not accept unsolicited book manuscripts or tolerate AI-generated work.
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems (no more than 10 pages) in one .doc or .docx file. For past contributors, wait at least 2 years (online) or 2 issues (print) after work last appeared before resubmitting. Notify immediately via Submittable if work is accepted elsewhere or to withdraw part of a submission. Cap: 100 per month Response: 3–6 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Bloodletter Magazine
venues.ai: Bloodletter is staunchly opposed to AI in the creative process. Does not accept work written or edited with generative AI; work will be pulled and submitters barred from future submissions.
venues.notes: Previously unpublished work only. Past contributors must wait one calendar year (two submission cycles) before submitting new work. Biannual themed issues; length and style determined by piece needs. Women, trans, and non-binary writers encouraged to submit.

waiver.note: Writers who cannot afford the $3 fee. Waiver available for writers if submission fee presents a financial burden

venues.name: Blue Earth Review
venues.pays: two contributor's copies
venues.ai: Do not accept AI-generated works.
venues.notes: Limit to 5 poems or 10 pages maximum per submission, all in a single document. Only previously unpublished work considered. Submit one poetry submission at a time. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Bluestem
venues.ai:
Not interested in publishing work assisted by or created with generative AI at any stage of the writing or editing process.</aiPolicy>
<parameter name="notes">Submit no more than 5 poems at one time. Current students and faculty of Eastern Illinois University cannot submit; former students may submit after at least five years post-matriculation. Incarcerated writers may submit via USPS.
venues.notes: Response: six months or more

venues.name: The Boiler
venues.ai: Will not accept submissions aided by LLMs (ChatGPT) or AI-generated art tools (Stable Diffusion) in whole or in part, unless submitter notifies editors in cover letter of specific tool used. Attribution to platform required upon publication.
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 poems in one document with cover letter via Submittable (no email submissions). One submission per genre per submission period. Place all work in one document; do not include cover letter or bio on file. Response: 8-12 months

venues.name: Bramble Literary Magazine
venues.pays: one contributor's copy of the print issue
venues.notes: Only Wisconsin poets and WFOP members welcome. One submission per issue. If accepted in previous issue, wait one issue before resubmitting. Include cover letter with mailing address, poet pic, 50-word bio, and poems in email body (no attachments unless special formatting needed, PDF preferred). No previously published poems.

venues.name: Breakwater Review
venues.ai: We do not accept work generated or assisted by artificial intelligence.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems per reading period in a single .doc or .docx file. Breakwater Review accepts simultaneous submissions but requires notification if work is accepted elsewhere. General poetry form closes when Peseroff Poetry Contest is open (February 15 - April 15).

venues.name: Broadsided Press
venues.notes: Poems must be 25 lines or less (shorter preferred). Submit 3-5 poems maximum. Original, unpublished work only. Editors read submissions twice yearly (spring and fall meetings); inbox cleared twice a year.

venues.name: Broken Lens Journal
venues.pays: No; not currently paying for submissions
venues.notes: Submit via Duosuma only (not email without prior permission). One submission at a time; wait for response before resubmitting. Previously published work (including social media) not accepted. If published with journal in last year, wait until next year to resubmit. Poems up to 5 per submission, max 10 pages total, 12pt Times New Roman, .doc/.docx/.pdf format with author name in filename and header. Cap: 25 per reading period Response: up to 3 months, may be longer

venues.name: Cagibi
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions encouraged. Only one submission at a time per poet. Resubmit only after hearing back. Does not accept previously published work in print or online. Response: six to eight months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Call Center Collective
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems in one file (Word DOC preferred or PDF). Simultaneous submissions allowed but notify immediately if work is accepted elsewhere. Sliding scale fee of $3–$10; editorial decisions unaffected by amount paid.

venues.name: The Capilano Review
venues.pays: $500 cash prize and publication
venues.notes: Submit up to 6 pages of poetry, prose, or experimental forms (PDF or Word). Work must be original and previously unpublished. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. International entries accepted. Fee includes one-year complimentary digital subscription. Response: January 2026

waiver.note: Indigenous entrants and those for whom the cost is a barrier. Submission fee waived for Indigenous entrants and those for whom cost is a barrier

venues.name: The Carolina Quarterly
venues.pays: Each contributor receives a $25 honorarium through PayPal as well as one copy of the issue in which their writing appears.
venues.ai: Carolina Quarterly has a zero-tolerance policy for AI. We do not accept submissions that have been generated, edited, or revised by AI.
venues.notes: Submit no more than 3 poems at a time, grouped in one file. Poems must be typed, single- or double-spaced, with full name, home address, and email included. We do accept simultaneous submissions, expecting notification if work is accepted elsewhere. Response: Expect six to twelve months for a decision.

venues.name: Cartridge Lit
venues.notes: Send up to 5 poems per submission. No previously published or plagiarized work. Simultaneous submissions encouraged but notify if accepted elsewhere. Acquires First North American Serial Rights; copyright reverts to author on publication. Response: As quickly as they can manage; appreciation for patience given small volunteer staff

venues.name: Cherry Tree
venues.pays: $20 per contributor and two contributor's copies
venues.ai: Submissions using AI must show significant imaginative or intellectual transformation, include process description, source links, delineate human and AI contributions, and specify AI origins. Work entirely generated by AI will not be accepted.
venues.notes: Maximum 5 poems per submission. Current Washington College students and those who graduated in the past 4 years are ineligible. Previously published work in Cherry Tree requires 2-year wait before resubmission. Simultaneous submissions allowed but notify venue if accepted elsewhere. Response: By end of November

waiver.note: Currently incarcerated writers. No fee waiver mentioned on page; incarcerated writers may submit by mail or email to lit_house@washcoll.edu instead of Submittable

venues.name: Chestnut Review
venues.pays: US $120 per piece, delivered on publication, via PayPal
venues.ai: We do not accept AI-generated work. Staff prohibited from using AI to evaluate work. All paid feedback is human-written.
venues.notes: Unpublished work only; no previously published or online-posted work. One active submission per category at a time. Simultaneous submissions encouraged with message notification for withdrawal. No re-submissions of declined pieces. Authors must wait two years after publication before resubmitting. Minimum age 18. Poems should be single-spaced, all in one document, each on new page. Response: 30-day turn-around for magazine submissions; refund submission fee if longer

venues.name: Chewers by Masticadores
venues.ai: Chewers by Masticadores does not allow Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). All content is produced by humans.
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 pieces including poetry via email in Word document or email body. Word count limit: 1,200 words per piece. Include 2-3 line bio (max 50 words) and website link. Simultaneous submissions allowed. Subject line: "Submission – your full name".

venues.name: The Cincinnati Review — miCRo
venues.pays: $30/page for poetry in print journal; $25 for miCRo posts
venues.ai: The Cincinnati Review does not publish or consider work generated using AI or LLMs unless the use is a dual creative-critical project.
venues.notes: One submission per calendar year for each print magazine genre. Current/former UC students, faculty, staff ineligible unless 2+ years removed from affiliation. Contributors must wait one year after appearance before resubmitting. For miCRo: submit up to 3 pieces, poems 32 lines or less. For print journal poetry: up to 5 poems, 10 manuscript pages max. Simultaneous submissions allowed; withdraw elsewhere-accepted poems promptly. Response: Typical response time is six months

venues.name: Clade Song
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 previously unpublished poems as a single Word (.doc) or .rtf file attachment. Poems should be 12-point font; indicate stanza breaks if over one page. .mp3 and compressed video files should not exceed 3 MB per email. Include brief cover letter with biographical note and full contact information (name, address, email, phone with area code). Simultaneous submissions accepted but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: varies Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cleaver Magazine
venues.ai: Cleaver welcomes diverse human voices, but we do not consider AI-generated or AI-assisted work.
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions welcomed with immediate notification if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not considered, though personal blog sharing may be acceptable. Translations welcome with author permission or for public domain works. Submissions reviewed through Subfolio online portal only; postal mail and email submissions not accepted.

waiver.note: Those for whom $5 fee presents any kind of hardship. Hardship waiver available; email to request no-fee submission link with genre category.

venues.name: Clockhouse Literary Journal
venues.pays: one contributor's copy and discount on volume purchases
venues.ai: We do not accept work generated in whole or in part by AI.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems, each as separate submission; thematic units of more than 3 poems submit as one. Each poem must be uploaded separately. Previously published work in CLOCKHOUSE requires one-issue gap before resubmission. Word docs preferred. Include 100-word bio or less. Simultaneous submissions welcomed if withdrawn if accepted. Response: up to four months after the close of submissions period Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Coal Hill Review
venues.notes: Check individual genre guidelines for specific submission requirements. Currently no open calls for submissions on this page. Response: 3-6 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cola Literary Review
venues.notes: Submissions open each fall (check back in September). Past chapbook contest winners available for purchase, but general submission route focuses on seasonal reading period. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Collaborature
venues.ai: No AI generated writing accepted. AI generated images are not preferred.
venues.notes: Collaborative poetry required: must be written by more than one author or include a collaboration of two individuals. Submit one submission (up to three poems) at a time, waiting to hear back before sending further submissions. Limit each poem to 100 lines or less. Simultaneous submissions okay; previously published work okay with proper credit noted. Response: 2 to 4 weeks

venues.name: The Columbus Review – Ouroborealis Poetry Prize
venues.pays: Prize pool: $30 grand prize, $10 honorable mention. Both awarded poems featured in next issue.
venues.notes: One poem per file per entry fee. Submit via contest form with file upload. Minimum 5 lines, maximum 40 lines. Previously unpublished work only. Open to writers residing in North America. Multiple entries per writer allowed. Simultaneous submissions welcome but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: Winners notified in February; public announcement March 1, 2027.

venues.name: A Common Well Journal
venues.ai: Absolutely NO AI GENERATED/ASSISTED MATERIAL
venues.notes: Send no more than 5 poems in no more than 7 pages; exceptions for longer poems and sequences. Poems must be previously unpublished. No AI-generated or AI-assisted material. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Compassiviste Publishing
venues.notes: Poetry accepted for quarterly anthology. Submit work with brief author bio. Submissions close August 28th (stated as 2026, but treating as recurring annual deadline). Multiple content types accepted (stories, essays, poetry, photography, digital artwork).

venues.name: The Cortland Review
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems per submission. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if work is placed elsewhere. All submissions must be previously unpublished. Do not use all-caps poem titles; left-justify and use 12-point font. Response: 3-4 months

venues.name: Cotton Xenomorph
venues.notes: This is a special series call for manifestos (six rules plus explanations). Manifestos do not count toward the one submission per month rule. Past contributors may submit regardless of the three-month wait time between acceptances. Include contributor bio in third person (less than 300 words) in email body. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cream City Review
venues.pays: Free subscription of 2 different issues beginning with the issue in which work appears
venues.ai: Cream city review does not accept any piece in which generativeAI or LLM models were used at any point in the creative process. Permanent ban if discovered.
venues.notes: Submit 5 poems in a single file (.doc, .docx, or PDF). No length restrictions per poem. No more than one submission per submission period. Wait at least 2 years before submitting again as a former contributor. Current UWM students and alumni who graduated in past two years are not eligible. Simultaneous submissions acceptable if CCR is notified at submission time; withdraw through Submittable if accepted elsewhere. Response: 4-7 months typically, up to 7 months

venues.name: diaCRITICS
venues.notes: Accepts poetry alongside fiction, essays, and hybrid forms. Special issue deadline December 1, 2026 for "The South" theme and mini-dispatches. Open submissions year-round via email. Response: two months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: DIAGRAM
venues.pays: No payment; contributors receive "props," love, and glory
venues.ai: Totally okay with AI-assisted work, as long as it rules. If it doesn't rule send it somewhere else.
venues.notes: Do not submit work titled "13 ways of looking at X"; do not mention Hopwoods; students should wait until no longer a student of editors to submit; previously published work not accepted (personal websites excepted); simultaneous submissions allowed if editor is informed immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: Typically 3 months, but can take longer; if no response after 6 months, check submissions manager

venues.name: Doubleback Review
venues.notes: Poets should send up to five poems in one document (Word preferred), each piece on a separate page, with name and email at the top of each page. Cover letter must specify where each piece was previously published; pieces must no longer be available online or in active print circulation. Only submit one packet at a time and wait for a determination before submitting again. Response: Around March 15 (for submissions Aug 16-Feb 15) or September 15 (for submissions Feb 16-Aug 15)

venues.name: DREGINALD
venues.notes: Submit 3–5 poems via Submittable in .doc/.docx with cover letter and bio. No more than 2 submissions per year; hold second submission until receiving response to first. Simultaneous submissions allowed but notify if work is accepted elsewhere. Does not accept previously published work. Response: 10 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Drift
venues.pays: $150 for poems
venues.ai: anything written by A.I.
venues.notes: Submit up to 6 poems in a single Word doc or PDF titled "lastname_firstname." Poets may submit no more than twice a year. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Driftwood Press
venues.pays: Contest: $300 USD (winner), $50 USD (up to 5 finalists). Full Collection: $500 USD plus 20% royalties
venues.ai: While AI may be useful tool for research, we do not accept AI generated works
venues.notes: Poetry In-House Contest: up to 5 poems, max 60 lines each, Sept 1–Jan 15 reading period, $25 fee. Full Collection submissions: year-round, 45–100 pages, $19.99 fee, simultaneous submissions allowed but update to withdrawn if accepted elsewhere. Single Poems Premium option available with ~1-week response. Response: Full Collection: three to six months target; Premium Single Poems: roughly one week

waiver.note: Each submitter receives free copy of chosen Driftwood Press poetry collection in mail

venues.name: EcoTheo Review
venues.ai: Work that has been created, in any part, with the assistance of AI tools is not eligible for submission or publication.
venues.notes: Poets must limit submissions to two per calendar year. Each submission may include no more than 3 poems and no more than 10 pages total. Submit poems as a single file. Previously published work is not accepted, but simultaneous submissions are allowed—notify promptly if accepted elsewhere. Response: 3 months

venues.name: El Portal
venues.notes: Accepts up to 5 poems per submission. Does not accept previously published work. Submit via Submittable in .doc, .docx, or .rtf formats. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: elsewhere
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 pieces of unlineated work, less than 1,000 words each. Simultaneous submissions accepted. Venue focuses on prose poetry and genre-blurring short prose works.

venues.name: Emergent Literary
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 poems in a single document with page breaks between poems and clearly delineated titles. Simultaneous submissions allowed; notify by replying to original email if work is accepted elsewhere. Response: 6 months

venues.name: Empty House Press
venues.notes: One submission per author per reading period. Submit 1-3 poems in a single document. Submissions currently closed for extended hiatus; will reopen on stated reading periods. Response: three months

venues.name: Epiphany
venues.pays: $75 per poem (print); $50 per poem (online only).
venues.notes: General submissions are for print issues only (May 1–June 15 for Fall/Winter; Nov 1–Dec 15 for Spring/Summer). All print submissions considered for online-only publication. A separate Fresh Voices Fellowship exists with different eligibility (early-career, BIPOC/writers of color, no advanced degree in writing/English, unpublished book, Sep 15–Oct 15, no fee). AI-generated work not accepted. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Those facing financial hardship. Those facing financial hardship may request a fee waiver via the contact form on the website.

venues.name: Exacting Clam
venues.notes: Submissions handled through Ola submission manager; email submissions will be ignored. For poetry submission guidelines, refer to Ola platform. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Fecund
venues.notes: Submit up to 10 previously unpublished poems per email to fecund.mag@gmail.com with subject line "Submission — [NAME]". Editorial staff unable to respond to all submissions or provide feedback on rejected pieces. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: FEED THE HOLY
venues.ai: NO AI-generated images accepted. NO AI-composed writing, only human writing.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems at a time; poems left-aligned; include JPEG photo and third-person bio (50 words or fewer); reprints acceptable with original publication noted; proofread before submitting; email to meelosmom@gmail.com with subject line "FEED THE HOLY SUBMISSION"; submit as Word document (Times New Roman 12, no PDFs); pace submissions and do not resubmit until your piece is published; all rights revert to author after publication.

venues.name: Figure 1
venues.notes: Does not accept previously published material including online publication. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify if work is accepted elsewhere. Contributors retain all rights but asked to acknowledge Figure 1 as first publisher. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Florida Review
venues.notes: Poets may submit up to five poems per submission. Fee applies to print edition; Aquifer (online) accepts poetry for $2.00. Simultaneous submissions allowed if withdrawn immediately upon acceptance elsewhere. Response: three months (sometimes longer)

waiver.note: Chapbook contest (2027 Jeanne Leiby Memorial): all entrants receive free one-year subscription

venues.name: F(r)iction
venues.pays: $25 per final printed page, plus two contributor copies
venues.notes: Up to five poems per submission, up to three pages per poem. Remove identifying information from manuscript and filename. Simultaneous submissions allowed; withdraw via Submittable if accepted elsewhere. Response: usually within one or two months

waiver.note: Free resubmissions for invited revisions

venues.name: Fugue
venues.ai: Do not send anything written by AI, cleaned up by AI, or anything where AI was used in its creation.
venues.notes: Submit up to three poems maximum in a single document (.pdf, .doc, or .docx). Submissions in multiple genres require separate submissions and separate fees. Simultaneous submissions allowed if noted in cover letter and immediate notification if accepted elsewhere. Response: four months, but sometimes longer; do not query before six months

waiver.note: Anyone experiencing financial hardship. If the submission fee presents financial hardship, contact the venue to request a fee-free submission option.

venues.name: The Garlic Press
venues.ai: We do not accept work generated by AI.
venues.notes: Submit via email attachment with poems anonymized. One submission per genre per reading period; wait six months between submissions if you've submitted before. Poems must be unpublished, proofread, and sent as single document (.doc/.docx or .pdf) with each poem on new page. Response: 2-4 months

venues.name: The Georgia Review
venues.pays: $4 per line for poetry, up to $800 per poem, plus 2 copies of issue and 50% discount on additional copies
venues.notes: Submit up to 10 pages of poetry; only one submission per submission period recommended. Do not submit work written or assisted by generative AI. Current University of Georgia students ineligible. Response: Aim to respond within ten months

waiver.note: Current subscribers to The Georgia Review. Journal subscribers may submit online at no cost during the general submissions period (excluding contests)

venues.name: The Good Life Review
venues.pays: $60 per piece published in a seasonal issue, $25 per piece published in Micro Monday
venues.notes: Submit via Submittable. TGLR is a paying market and a 501C3 nonprofit literary journal. Poetry submissions follow standard submission guidelines (see their guidelines page).

venues.name: Good River Review
venues.notes: Lyric writers (poets) submit up to five poems or micro pieces, no more than ten pages at a time. Current students at the Naslund-Mann School of Writing at Spalding University are not eligible. Do not submit previously published material or work currently in press elsewhere. Response: up to four months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Guernica
venues.notes: Only completed manuscripts accepted; no pitches. Submissions through Submittable only; see Submittable for current editorial guidelines. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Half Mystic
venues.notes: This page lists published contributors only. No submission guidelines, fees, deadlines, or other details about how to submit are provided on this page. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Hanging Loose Press
venues.notes: Send up to six poems by mail with SASE; do not staple. Do not submit simultaneously or by fax/email (except high school submissions via email). Wait at least six months before resubmitting. High school writers submit via email as Word/PDF attachment with identification. Name and address required on each page. Response: up to six months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Harpur Palate
venues.notes: Submit 1-3 poems per reading period (no more than 5 pages total), one poetry submission per reading period. Cannot accept submissions from current Binghamton University students, faculty, staff, or recent alumni. Cap: 200 submissions per reading period

venues.name: Harvard Review
venues.notes: Maximum 5 poems per submission. Writers may submit no more than twice a year. Manuscripts must be paginated and clearly labeled with author name on every page. Simultaneous submissions encouraged; notify if accepted elsewhere. Response: Within 6 months, occasionally longer Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Writers experiencing financial hardship. Financial hardship waiver available by email request

venues.name: Heavy Feather Review – Online Features
venues.pays: Contributor copies for print; online contributors receive no payment
venues.notes: Save poetry as one document (doc, docx, pdf). Cover letters encouraged but not required. Simultaneous submissions allowed; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. One standalone piece per "Side A" feature. Original work only; HFR takes first serial rights. Response: 30 days for response; inquire after 60 days

venues.name: HOOT Review
venues.pays: ~$25 average (30% of $2 per submission when more established)
venues.notes: Poetry must be under 10 lines and under 150 words total to fit on a postcard. Submit up to two pieces per submission. If accepted, wait one year before resubmitting; if rejected, wait six months. Must accept potential "creative reformatting" of line breaks for postcard design. Reprints allowed if previously published status is noted. Response: 1-6 months (within a month to six months if on schedule, about 50% of the time)

waiver.note: Free submissions by postal mail. Free online submissions to onlinesubmissions@hootreview.com

venues.name: Ice Queen Magazine
venues.pays: $50 per contributor
venues.notes: Community-based nomination process for monthly featured contributor. Poets may submit 1-4 poems. Work must mention or relate to food. Contributors also provide a favorite/family recipe and interview. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Identity Theory
venues.pays: No; nominations for Pushcart Prize, Best Small Fictions, Best Microfiction, Best of the Net; social media promotion; occasional gift rewards
venues.ai: Do not submit AI-generated or otherwise plagiarized work.
venues.notes: Submissions are always open with free email option year-round. Free Submittable period at beginning of each month runs until cap is reached. Simultaneous submissions welcome; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work unlikely but considered if no longer online. Response: 1-3 months for most submissions; 1 day to 1 month for microfiction

venues.name: Ink & Ribbon Press — The LemonLight Prize
venues.pays: $2000 winner; $250 per honorable mention (4); publication in anthology
venues.notes: The LemonLight Prize is a contest with a $3,000 prize fund, currently closed (2026 winner announced). The 2027 prize returns spring 2027. No submission fee stated for the prize. The venue also accepts full manuscripts and poetry selections year-round through their open reading for $15 reading fee. Response: 6–10 week response (open reading only) Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Indianapolis Review
venues.ai: AI generated art or writing not accepted; work must be your own. Exceptions for collage/cento which should be noted.
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems or 10 pages of poetry. Include third person bio and optional author photo. Simultaneous submissions encouraged; do not email withdrawals if accepted. Currently accepting Indiana-themed submissions for special 10-year anniversary issue in 2027. Response: up to 4 months

venues.name: Interpret Magazine
venues.ai: Please don't send texts written, edited, or translated by AI. This is easily detectable and will result in your submission being deleted.
venues.notes: Maximum 3 poems per submission. Must be original, unpublished work in magazines worldwide (excluding private social media). Requires 30-word third-person bio. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify if accepted elsewhere. Works in French, Portuguese, Spanish, or Italian need not include English translation; all other languages require full English translation. Response: 1 to 3 months; fast-track replies within 5 working days Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: All authors. Submission is free for all readers who need it to be; simply send a submission as normal without paying. No questions asked, no proof required.

venues.name: J Journal
venues.notes: Submit up to three poems via email. Work should relate to justice theme. J Journal seeks new writing on justice across multiple genres. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Josephine Quarterly
venues.pays: $30 per poem
venues.ai: Do not consider AI assisted or generated poems.
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 unpublished poems. One submission at a time. If accepted elsewhere, immediately notify editors or add note via Submittable. Cap: 200 per month Response: 7-10 weeks

venues.name: The Journal
venues.ai: The Journal does not accept work generated by AI. Submissions including work generated by AI will be rejected. If accepted work is found to be written by generative AI, the publication contract will be terminated immediately.
venues.notes: Limit poetry to 3 poems in single .doc, .docx, or .pdf document with 12 pt Garamond font. Multiple submissions not accepted; wait for response before submitting again. Recent contributors must wait at least one year from publication before submitting again. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify at time of submission. Response: at least eight months

waiver.note: Those unable to access Submittable due to disability. Disability access accommodation: those who cannot access Submittable due to disability may email for alternative submission method.

venues.name: JuxtaProse
venues.notes: Submit up to five poems via Submittable, each no more than two pages. Format submission title as number of poems (e.g. "3 POEMS"). Include contact info on first page of each poem. Simultaneous submissions welcome; use Note feature to specify which poems are accepted elsewhere. Response: 8-12 weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Kartika Review
venues.notes: Submit only once per calendar year per category unless solicited by editors. Strongly prefer poems under 100 lines. Withdraw if accepted elsewhere; reprints not published except as solicited.

venues.name: Kenyon Review
venues.pays: $0.16 per published word of poetry (minimum $40, maximum $200)
venues.notes: Submit up to 6 poems as a single document. No more than one submission per genre. Simultaneous submissions permitted but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Do not send emailed submissions; use Submittable. Paper submissions available only to those without internet access, postmarked by deadline, with SASE to: SUBMISSIONS, The Kenyon Review, 102 W. Wiggin St., Gambier, OH 43022. Response: six months

venues.name: Kitchen Table Quarterly
venues.notes: Submit once per reading period to one category only. Only previously unpublished works accepted; personal blogs and social media do not count as publication. Translations require permission from original writer. Notify immediately if work is accepted elsewhere. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Lavender Review
venues.ai: By submitting poetry, you certify you have not used or reproduced artificial intelligence technologies or systems in any manner
venues.notes: Submit 3-6 poems in one file via Submittable. Do not resubmit until receiving a response. Previously published work not accepted. First North American Serial Rights and archival rights required upon acceptance. Response: usually within two months

venues.name: Leavings Literary Magazine
venues.pays: $10 per accepted piece
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 previously unpublished poems, single-spaced unless spacing is integral to formatting, each poem on separate page. Include third-person bio (50-100 words) with submission. Year-round submissions; consider work no longer under consideration if no response within one year. Response: up to one year

venues.name: LIT
venues.pays: No monetary compensation; accepted contributors for print receive physical copies
venues.notes: Submit no more than 3 poems or 7 pages. Do not submit more than once during any given submission period. Must receive a reply before submitting new work. Submit as single document with cover letter (3rd person bio and social media handles). Response: 90 days Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Litbreak
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems per submission; poems accepted/declined as a group with no individual withdrawals allowed. Withdrawals after acceptance result in disqualification. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Cap: 50 unpaid submissions per month

venues.name: LONESOME PRESS
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems in a single document with cover letter; not more than 1 poem per page (max 10 pages total). Simultaneous submissions not specified.

venues.name: Los Angeles Review
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems in a single document; do not submit each poem separately. If a poem is accepted elsewhere, notify via Submittable but do not withdraw entire submission if other poems remain under consideration.

venues.name: Lost Pilots Lit
venues.notes: Submit up to 4 poems in one file. Maximum 2 submissions per calendar year; wait at least 1 year after acceptance before resubmitting. Simultaneous submissions encouraged. Requires First North American Serial Rights. No previously published work. Cap: 2 per calendar year Response: approximately 2 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Mailbox to Another World
venues.notes: Submit up to five poems in a single file via email. Indicate if poems are separate or a collection. 12-point font, single-spaced, numbered pages with author name and email at top; include brief bio. Response: one week to three weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Mammouth Poetry
venues.notes: Submit up to six poems in a Word document. Simultaneous submissions welcome; notify if work is accepted elsewhere. Bio or work link optional. Response: within two weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Mantle
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 previously unpublished poems in email body or single .doc/.docx/.rtf/.odt file. Wait for response before submitting again; minimum 3-month wait after acceptance before resubmitting. Response: 60 days

venues.name: Maudlin House
venues.notes: Rolling submissions, year-round. Submit 3-5 poems in a single document. One submission at a time; wait at least four weeks after response before submitting again. No previously published material. Response: about four weeks (often sooner)

venues.name: Midwest Review
venues.pays: one free issue copy
venues.notes: Submit 1-5 poems or up to 10 pages. Simultaneous submissions allowed; notify if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not accepted. Wait one year before resubmitting if work was in a previous issue. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Any writer with financial need; writers who have been or are incarcerated. Writers with financial need can email to request a fee waiver. Incarcerated writers may send handwritten submissions by mail.

venues.name: Modern Poetry in Translation
venues.pays: Yes, contributors are paid
venues.notes: Only published translations of poetry accepted, not original English-language work. Work must be previously unpublished. Simultaneous submissions allowed if venue is informed immediately if work is accepted elsewhere. Translator is responsible for clearing rights and permissions. Response: within four months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Moko: Caribbean Arts and Letters
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 poems in a single 12pt Word (.doc) file. Include brief biography and contact information. One submission per discipline at a time. No previously published work accepted. Response: at least 90 days Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Moon City Review
venues.ai: Moon City Review does not consider, accept, or contract AI-generated work.
venues.notes: Authors are limited to six poems total per submission period, submitted in a single document. Simultaneous submissions acceptable with prompt notification of acceptance elsewhere.

venues.name: MoonPark Review
venues.notes: Submit prose poems (no line breaks) via email one piece at a time; wait for response before sending another. Up to three micros (under 200 words each) may be sent in one submission. Include short bio. Simultaneous submissions permitted; notify when piece is no longer available. 750 word maximum. Response: within 3 months

venues.name: New Orleans Review
venues.pays: $50 per poem
venues.notes: Submit up to five pages of poems. No previously published work. Simultaneous submissions okay. Use withdraw function if work accepted elsewhere.

waiver.note: No fee waiver information stated on page

venues.name: new sinews
venues.notes: Submit poems as a Word DOC to the email. Currently open for issue 10. Submissions are year-round.

venues.name: Pacifica Literary Review
venues.notes: Submit no more than three poems in a single document. Do not submit poems individually from the same author. Reporting time varies from one to four months. All pieces must be unpublished. Response: one to four months

venues.name: Painted Bride Quarterly
venues.ai: Not interested in work generated by AI or LLMs; only fully human creations accepted.
venues.notes: Up to 3 poems per submission in a single document. Only one submission per author per submission opening. Do not include personal information in submitted document. Previously unpublished work only (including self-published). Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if work is accepted elsewhere. Cap: Internal submissions cap mentioned; venue may close early if reached Response: 2 to 5 months for poetry

venues.name: Palette Poetry
venues.pays: $50 per accepted poem
venues.notes: Featured Poetry submissions are always free and always open. Accepted poems receive $50 per poem payment.

venues.name: Passionfruit Review
venues.notes: Submissions are year-round and always free. The journal publishes monthly issues primarily devoted to poetry, with space for prose and other creative pieces.

venues.name: The Pinch
venues.notes: Poetry readings occur in March, June, September, and December. Do not submit additional work before hearing back from the journal. We rarely publish work over 4,000 words and do not publish excerpts, translations, dramas, or screenplays. Response: up to six months (180 days)

venues.name: Pithead Chapel
venues.ai: Please do not use AI to create your work. We do not want those pieces.
venues.notes: Accepts prose poetry only (1-3 prose poems per submission); no traditional lineated forms. One submission at a time; wait one month between declined submissions. Previously published work not considered. Max 4,000 words. Cap: 300 per month across all genres Response: two months

venues.name: Plumas Revista
venues.notes: Send up to five poems per submission to plumascolectiva@gmail.com with "Poetry Submission" in the subject line. Include a short bio with any Instagram handles you would like tagged. Plumas Revista especially encourages submissions from LGBTQIA+, Disabled, Black, and Indigenous creators of color.

venues.name: Poetries in English
venues.pays: honorarium
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions welcome. Critique option available for extended comments and two-week response time. Executive Editor responds personally to every submission. Response: 3-6 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: poetry.onl
venues.pays: $60 per poem via Venmo (U.S.) or PayPal (international), for poems accepted after 10/01/2022
venues.notes: Submit 1–5 poems per file (.doc, .docx, .pdf). One no-fee submission per month; additional submissions in the same period are returned unread. Wait for response before next submission. Cap: 40 per month Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Those with financial need. Available upon request for those with financial need

venues.name: Porcupine Literary
venues.pays: No
venues.notes: Only for work from a teacher's perspective about teaching. Submit once every six months maximum. Poetry: 1-5 poems, no longer than 5 pages. Submit via email as Word .doc or .docx with subject line 'LastName Poetry'.

venues.name: Portland Review
venues.notes: Submit up to three poems in a single document. One submission per author per category per reading period. Work must be original and unpublished. 12-point font standard. Response: six months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Press Pause Press
venues.notes: Submit up to ten poems in one document, single-spaced in Times New Roman, Garamond, or similar standard fonts. No "fun" fonts.

waiver.note: Free during January 1 - April 30 and September 1 - December 31. $5 fee May 1 - August 31.

venues.name: Puerto del Sol
venues.notes: Limit one submission per reading period. Do not submit previously published work. Include third-person bio (under 100 words) and cover letter. Submit up to 5 poems in one .docx or .doc file. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify promptly if accepted elsewhere. Response: 6-8 months

venues.name: Puerto del Sol – Black Voices Series
venues.notes: Submitters limited to five poems per submission in one document. Do not submit more than once per reading period. Simultaneous submissions accepted but must notify promptly if accepted elsewhere. No previously published work. Reading period: August-April annually; submissions closed until further notice due to high volumes. Response: 6-8 months

venues.name: Puerto del Sol — Voz Series
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems in one document (.docx or .doc preferred). Include third-person bio (under 100 words) and cover letter. Do not submit more than once per reading period. No previously published work. General submissions currently closed until further notice due to high submission volumes. Response: 6-8 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Quartet
venues.pays: No payment; contributors receive admiration and support
venues.ai: AI generated poems will not be considered
venues.notes: Send up to 3 unpublished poems in one Word document attachment (one poem per page). Include name in subject line and name/contact info on each poem. Simultaneous submissions encouraged but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. After publication, wait at least two submission periods before resubmitting. Submissions outside reading periods will not be considered. Response: Within 4 weeks after submissions close

venues.name: Radar Poetry
venues.ai: We do not consider AI-generated poems.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 original, previously unpublished poems in a single document with no identifying information; cover letter and bio required in comments box. One submission per reading period. Former contributors must wait 2 years after publication before resubmitting to regular categories. Response: Within 60 days

waiver.note: Free submissions accepted at beginning of each reading period until cap reached; $3.00 'Tip Jar' submissions continue after free cap is reached

venues.name: Radon Journal
venues.pays: $25 per poem
venues.ai: AI submissions are not allowed at Radon.
venues.notes: Submit up to five poems in a single Word document with no line limit. Single-spaced formatting using 11pt standard font (Garamond, Times New Roman, Aptos, or Lato) requested. Authors published in Radon cannot submit to the immediately following issue. Reprints no longer accepted as of 2025.
